{{Quote|A few years ago, Beryl and I robbed an Imperial treasury station. The heist went bad. I escaped, Beryl didn't.|Risha Drayen|<ref name="The Vault" />}}
A few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the criminals [[Risha Drayen]] and [[Beryl Thorne]]<ref name="The Vault" /> '''raided''' [[Imperial Pay Station RMH-1973]], a pay station of the [[Imperial Treasury Department]]. Operating under the alias "Risha Xanthous," Drayen masterminded a heist of the station<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> with Thorne, but the heist failed and Thorne was captured. Drayen escaped,<ref name="The Vault" /> causing the Treasury Department to issue a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on "Risha Xanthous,"<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and Thorne resented Drayen for not rescuing her from the Imperials.<ref name="The Vault" />

==Behind the scenes==
The raid on Pay Station RMH-1973 was first mentioned in the [[Voidhound|smuggler]] class mission "The Vault" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]] and released in [[2011]].<ref name="The Vault" />
